howItWorks.title: How Lyyli works in practice
howItWorks.step1.title: Lyyli learns from you
howItWorks.step1.description: You upload brand guidelines and specify that external communication uses a more formal tone than Slack. Lyyli saves this and learns how your organization communicates.
howItWorks.step2.title: AI suggests content
howItWorks.step2.description: You write in Slack: "I need a LinkedIn post about our new client." Lyyli suggests three options – each sounds like you, but polished and ready to publish.
howItWorks.step3.title: You collaborate
howItWorks.step3.description: Your colleague sees the suggestion, comments, and proposes a change. You edit the message together. The result sounds like you, not a machine.
howItWorks.step4.title: Lyyli publishes for you
howItWorks.step4.description: You approve the message with one click. Lyyli publishes it on LinkedIn, emails a version to the client, and shares a summary in Slack – automatically.
